## 2026-01-28 - Markdown Report Navigation
**Learning:** Long-form Markdown reports generated by CLI tools lack navigability, making them hard to consume. Explicit HTML anchors (`<a name="..."></a>`) are more reliable than implicit Markdown header links for internal navigation.
**Action:** Always include a Table of Contents, explicit anchors, and "Back to Top" links in generated Markdown reports to treat them as proper user interfaces.
